scope.guest_change: only framed proc maps diagnostic reader plus corresponding init diagnostic call; no business function or hardware change

prerequisites: direct user approval for this new diagnostic package; do not reuse r6 consumed allowance
correct volume UUID and candidate/frozen baseline hashes
exclusive acquisition of both existing FX3 locks; queue if busy, do not preempt
fresh owned output root; preserve all original receipts
runtime_evidence_required: two-key entry/return bytes and return values if reached
native receipt success/failure, output code and elapsed timing
owned child reaped and locks released; independent postrun check
original and candidate input hashes unchanged
serial faults scan without inferring menu success
failure_policy: stop at first run outcome; preserve failure and cleanup evidence; no second start
